items.title: Equity mutual funds attract ₹29,329 crore in August, highest in 4 months
items.description: Strong investor interest in mid-cap and small-cap funds lifted equity mutual fund inflows nearly 19 per cent from July, even as overall mutual fund inflows fell sharply

items.title: Investors pour record amount into MFs through monthly savings plans in Aug
items.description: Flows via systematic investment plans, the preferred route ‌for retail investors, marked a 1.1% increase in contributions to ₹32,297 crore ($3.39 billion) last month
